title: Day 3 Broncos Camp Report: 1st Day in Pads, Why Pat Bryant CONTINUES to Shine | Orange & Blue Today
text: Day 3 of Broncos Training Camp brought a lighter workload — but the first day in pads always reveals who’s ready for real football, and on Orange & Blue Today, Cecil breaks down everything that popped on Monday. The standout of the day was Pat Bryant, who continues stacking strong practices. Physical routes, confident finishes, and a presence that keeps showing up whenever pads come on. Cecil explains why Bryant’s rise matters in a suddenly crowded WR room. On defense, Riley Moss made plays all over the field — sticky coverage, quick reactions, and a level of confidence that suggests he’s ready to push for a bigger role in 2026. And at quarterback, Bo Nix continues to run the offense cleanly. Efficient operation, strong command, and no wasted movement. Even on a lighter day, his consistency stood out. Pads are on. Competition is rising. And the real evaluations begin this week. 🔥 In this episode: Why Pat Bryant keeps flashing whenever pads come on How Riley Moss is making a push in the secondary Bo Nix’s continued clean operation of the offense What a lighter Day 3 tells us before intensity ramps up If you’re rolling with us through camp, hit LIKE, SUBSCRIBE, and drop your Day 3 standout — who impressed you most.

title: Day 2 Broncos Camp Report: Competition Abounds, Even at Backup QB | Orange & Blue Today
text: It’s a special OBT After Dark as Cecil and Mase break down Day 2 of Broncos Training Camp — a session packed with competition, standout performances, and a few storylines that could reshape the depth chart before preseason even begins. Bo Nix had an up‑and‑down day — sharp when the timing was clean, shaky when the defense disguised looks. It’s part of the learning curve, and Cecil and Mase explain why Saturday’s swings matter for his early development. The backup QB battle is officially heating up. Sam Ehlinger stacked another strong practice, showing command and decisiveness. Can he push Jarrett Stidham for the No. 2 job. The guys break down how real this competition is — and why the coaches are watching it closely. And then there’s the wildcard: The Broncos’ interest in Taysom Hill. What role would he play. Why now. And how would his arrival impact the QB room, special teams, and offensive packages. Cecil and Mase dig into the ripple effects of a potential Hill addition.
